verdict.rationale: A patent and trade mark office's search and filing services could plausibly offer API, batch, or headless access, so the automation axis applies. The evidence shows only interactive web portals (DEPATISnet, DPMAregister, DPMAdirektWeb) and downloadable desktop filing software (DPMAdirektPro), with nothing documented on headless, CLI, API, or CI-driven use. The register host's robots.txt also disallows general crawling.
